notes: This catalog records dataset provenance and preprocessing used in the layer-wise scFM evaluation. Raw h5ad files and checkpoints are not distributed with the repo; provide local paths in a copy of this file.

pbmc3k.source_name: 10x Genomics 3k PBMCs from a Healthy Donor

preprocessing.notes: Use raw counts for tokenization/extraction unless the model-specific script documents otherwise. Filter rare classes before stratified CV.
Some local Zheng68k files use 'Cell type' instead of 'cell_type'; set label_key explicitly.

czi_meninges_immune.source_name: Comprehensive cellular and spatial atlas of the developing human meninges, immune-cell subset
czi_meninges_immune.reference: Degenhard et al., Nature Communications 2024; CZ CELLxGENE Discover

preprocessing.notes: Use the immune-cell subset h5ad used in the manuscript.
Use the testis subset and retain cell types with sufficient support for five-fold CV.

preprocessing.folding: single-seed five-fold split at perturbation level, stratified by perturbation size
preprocessing.target: mean expression delta relative to matched controls
preprocessing.normalization: standardized ridge probe with training-fold-only scaling
